name: ai-waves-stagger
description: A Normal AI's full battlegroups leave one at a time. Eight tanks spawned for a Normal balanced AI fill both of its battlegroups at once; Normal holds its first attack until 4:00, and the groups must then leave 90 s apart (waves.launch_gap_s in data/ai/balanced.json), not together. Before, every group that filled up during the hold left in the same second.

checks.name: nothing left before the first attack time
the second group left 90 s later
